english_events.title: Emperor Charlemagne Crowned
english_events.description: Charlemagne crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Medieval era, establishing Germanic empire dominating Central Europe.

english_events.title: Otto I Crowned Holy Roman Emperor
english_events.description: Otto the Great crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Medieval Germany, beginning Saxon dynasty and strengthening authority.

english_events.title: Frederick Barbarossa Becomes Emperor
english_events.description: Frederick Barbarossa elected Holy Roman Emperor in Medieval era, beginning his rule marked by conflicts with Italy.

english_events.title: Johannes Gutenberg Prints First Bible
english_events.description: Gutenberg completes first movable-type Bible in Mainz during Renaissance, revolutionizing literacy and knowledge.

english_events.title: Martin Luther Posts 95 Theses
english_events.description: Monk Luther nails 95 Theses to Wittenberg Castle Church door, sparking the Protestant Reformation.

english_events.title: Investiture Controversy Begins
english_events.description: German Emperor Henry IV and Pope clash over bishop appointments in Medieval era, triggering constitutional crisis.

english_events.title: Henry's Walk to Canossa
english_events.description: Emperor Henry IV travels to Canossa in Medieval era, humbly begging Pope for forgiveness in Investiture controversy.

english_events.title: Frederick Barbarossa Dies on Crusade
english_events.description: Emperor Frederick Barbarossa drowns crossing river in Anatolia during Third Crusade, shocking Christendom.

english_events.title: Golden Bull Issued
english_events.description: Emperor Charles IV issues Golden Bull in Medieval era, establishing constitutional framework for imperial elections.

english_events.title: Diet of Worms
english_events.description: Monk Luther defends teachings before Emperor Charles V in Reformation era, refusing to recant.

translated_events.title: Kaiser Karl der Große gekrönt
translated_events.description: Karl der Große wird im Mittelalter zum Römischen Kaiser gekrönt und gründet ein germanisches Reich, das Mitteleuropa dominiert.

translated_events.title: Otto I. zum Römischen Kaiser gekrönt
translated_events.description: Otto der Große wird im mittelalterlichen Deutschland zum Römischen Kaiser gekrönt und begründet die sächsische Dynastie.

translated_events.title: Friedrich Barbarossa wird Kaiser
translated_events.description: Friedrich Barbarossa wird im Mittelalter zum Römischen Kaiser gewählt und beginnt seine von Konflikten mit Italien geprägte Herrschaft.

translated_events.title: Johannes Gutenberg druckt erste Bibel
translated_events.description: Gutenberg vollendet in Mainz die erste Bibel mit beweglichen Lettern in der Renaissance und revolutioniert die Alphabetisierung.

translated_events.title: Martin Luther veröffentlicht 95 Thesen
translated_events.description: Der Mönch Luther schlägt 95 Thesen an die Wittenberger Schlosskirche und löst die Reformation aus.

portuguese_diacritics_events.title: Fundação do Condado Portucalense
portuguese_diacritics_events.description: Medieval Henrique de Borgonha recebe território ibérico como dote, estabelecendo condado autónomo que evoluiria para um reino independente.

portuguese_diacritics_events.title: Batalha de São Mamede Travada
portuguese_diacritics_events.description: Medieval Afonso Henriques derrota as forças da mãe no norte de Portugal, assumindo o controlo e iniciando a independência de Leão-Castela.

portuguese_diacritics_events.title: Portugal Declara a Independência
portuguese_diacritics_events.description: Medieval Afonso Henriques proclama-se primeiro Rei de Portugal após a vitória de Ourique, estabelecendo uma monarquia independente.

portuguese_diacritics_events.title: Assinatura do Tratado de Zamora
portuguese_diacritics_events.description: Medieval Leão reconhece a independência portuguesa sob Afonso VII em Zamora, estabelecendo formalmente o reino soberano face a Espanha.
